import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_sumsq_shifted_b()
    return nothing
end

function sumsq_shifted_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, alpha, alphab, beta, betab, i_n)
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + (alpha * u[i_x] + beta) ^ 2
    end
    for i_x = i_n:-1:1
        alphab = alphab + u[i_x] * ((2 * (alpha * u[i_x] + beta)) * lossb[1])
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + alpha * ((2 * (alpha * u[i_x] + beta)) * lossb[1])
        betab = betab + (2 * (alpha * u[i_x] + beta)) * lossb[1]
    end
    return (alphab, betab)
end

function initstacks_sumsq_shifted_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function sumsq_shifted_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, alpha, alphab, beta, betab, i_n)
    alphab = CuArray([alphab])
    betab = CuArray([betab])
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_sumsq_shifted_b_1!(alpha, beta, i_n, loss, u)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_sumsq_shifted_b_2!(alpha, alphab, beta, betab, i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    alphab = (Array(alphab))[1]
    betab = (Array(betab))[1]
    return (alphab, betab)
end

function cuda_kernel_sumsq_shifted_b_1!(alpha, beta, i_n, loss, u)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += (alpha * u[i_x] + beta) ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_sumsq_shifted_b_2!(alpha, alphab, beta, betab, i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    CUDA.@atomic alphab[1] += u[i_x] * ((2 * (alpha * u[i_x] + beta)) * lossb[1])
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + alpha * ((2 * (alpha * u[i_x] + beta)) * lossb[1])
    CUDA.@atomic betab[1] += (2 * (alpha * u[i_x] + beta)) * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 3
__base_loss = Float64[1.0559676194046643, -1.7386903045507713, 1.2483486406194497, -1.3620124824340132]
__base_u = Float64[-0.24943579003392274, -1.311898050748365, 0.9018280547902268, -0.6988786616910534]

__base_beta = 0.9654550655261834
__seed_alpha = [-1.337677526391229, 0.46184399542828797, 0.21416106536729326]
__seed_beta = [-0.4581928031373383, 0.9654550655261834, -0.304668213511021]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-0.007499299817589766, -0.8691141403963666, 3.1080766448189157, 0.8070528839012898], Float64[1.0559676194046643, -1.7386903045507713, 1.2483486406194497, -1.3620124824340132], Float64[-0.4531669977488983, 1.277951281130676, -0.6980960571397398, 0.9959405926788525]]
__seed_u = [Float64[0.6112315241229709, -1.1172811955341369, -0.3345990913086426, -0.9509307018890292], Float64[-0.24943579003392274, -1.311898050748365, 0.9018280547902268, -0.6988786616910534], Float64[3.05736616079054, 0.014876652191555742, 0.5831384376301159, 0.7858998573419875]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:3
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  alpha_val_cpu = __base_alpha; alpha_sh_cpu = __seed_alpha[__trial]
  alpha_val_gpu = __base_alpha; alpha_sh_gpu = __seed_alpha[__trial]
  beta_val_cpu = __base_beta; beta_sh_cpu = __seed_beta[__trial]
  beta_val_gpu = __base_beta; beta_sh_gpu = __seed_beta[__trial]
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_sumsq_shifted_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_sumsq_shifted_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = sumsq_shifted_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, alpha_val_cpu, alpha_sh_cpu, beta_val_cpu, beta_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = sumsq_shifted_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, alpha_val_gpu, alpha_sh_gpu, beta_val_gpu, beta_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ret_cpu

  local_max = 0.0

  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))

  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[1], ret_gpu_t[1]))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[2], ret_gpu_t[2]))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 7.500000000000001e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
